column1: # Pakistan, pk.karachi: no binding state timetable; the Karachi convention (18/18, Hanafi) is the
# massive majority. Fit on the Deobandi Karachi Daimi (permanent) timetable's June and December
# pages (both solstices, Banuri Town / Prof. Abdul Latif; banuri.edu.pk, all rights reserved).
# September (the equinox month) and Dawat-e-Islami's Karachi AJAX (a later, Barelvi member whose
# sharing is "not allowed"; used only to fit and prove) were first tried as held-out rows: both
# showed early starts against the June+December margins (proof.md), so both are folded into the
# fit set (never tuned on the holdout silently: the shortfall and widening are recorded in
# proof.md); nothing is held out for this entry. Subh sadiq is one printed time serving as both the
# Fajr start and the end of eating (F+E). Zawal is skipped: it prints the noon caution window, not
# a Dhuhr start. Both Asr columns are printed in the Daimi table (As, Ah); the entry itself is
# End of eating (audit of 3 Oct 2026, before Ramadan 1448): Dawat-e-Islami's Karachi Fajr is likewise the dawn at which sehri
# ends, so its row is checked as F+E too.
# Lenient by up to 59 s (fix round of 3 Oct 2026): the AJAX source prints seconds, and the table rounds
# its Fajr UP to the minute (right for a start), so as the end of eating's reference it can stand up
# to 59 s after the authority's moment; a floored Fajr is the strict reference. Since 18 Oct 2026 (E16,
# ruling R147) the Dawat-e-Islami rows read the derived month off-di-karachi-2026-09-e.txt (archive/code/
# moral-auth-world/southasia/di_floor_e.py), whose E column is the printed Fajr less one minute: never later
# than the floored seconds (ceil - 1 <= floor), so a day at +0 against the printed Fajr no longer passes.
# A later capture (no monitor source or fetcher covers Dawat-e-Islami; it is read by hand) goes through
# di_floor_e.py too, or is archived with its floored seconds in a column of its own: the gate refuses F+E on
# any table whose header says its times were rounded up (Gate.roundedUp, ruling R149), and GateManifestTest
# refuses it on an off-di-* path without the archive.
